$comment: DRC seeded field, FIELD 1 instance -- truth manifest, NOT SCORING READY: the GPR dataset for this field (7: GSSI 400 MHz UtilityScan cart) is not public (Zenodo 19100554 has no file; the web map lists only human AIU interpretations for it).

Items, classes and depths are identical across the web map's Field 1, 2 and 3 tables and match Baur et al. 2023 Table 2 cell by cell (independently transcribed; see truth_source.cross_check). Geometry is NOT identical across fields: each field has its own frame.
title: Demining Research Community seeded field, Pawnee OK -- Field 1

papers: Baur, Steinberg, Frucci, Brinkley (2023) JCWD 27.3 -- grid design, burial method, Tables 1-3
Baur et al. (2026) Remote Sensing 18(13):2182, doi 10.3390/rs18132182
truth_source.dataset: Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.19100554, CC-BY-4.0 (no GPR files, no target table)

cross_check.against: Subterra's transcription of Baur et al. 2023 Table 2

exhaustive.statement: Not attested. Every cell is accounted for, but the published counts disagree (143 items in the text; 141 + 9 'Empty' in Table 1; 139 filled + 11 blank here), survey markers (GCPs) lie in and around the grid, and no source states the table lists every object in the field.

frames.origin: EPSG:32614 (WGS84 / UTM 14N), from the web map's WGS84 coordinates
frames.registration_note: No GPR data or trajectory is public for this field, so no radar position exists in any frame.

depth_reference_surfaces.description: soil surface at the item's hole at burial, where the horizontal ruler lay (Baur et al. 2023); holes refilled level, not compacted

open_questions.statement: The GPR dataset for Field 1 has no file or link in Zenodo 19100554 and only human AIU interpretations on the web map, although the 2026 paper says all 34 datasets were released.
How the web-map item coordinates were obtained (GNSS at placement, orthomosaic picks, nominal layout) is not stated; they imply a different cell spacing than the paper's 2 m x 1.5 m.
143 items (text) vs 141 + 9 'Empty' (Table 1) vs 139 filled + 11 blank cells (tables); which blank cells are documented-empty is unresolved.

Depth is described as 'to the center of mass' but read from a ruler resting on the item's uppermost surface; which point it refers to is unresolved. The web map also carries a per-dataset 'True Depth' that differs from the burial depth.
GCP markers lie inside the grid; their material and burial are not stated.
